rules: NOT_RUN requires prior blocked execution and no delegated files
Started/unknown or missing terminal records never imply success; retain existing partial files
Child called: invocation and both raw logs required; PASS also requires valid terminal records and matching exit
Successful compile/hash/gate requires all three valid build files and exactly one valid compile result
Existing partial JSON retained before parsing; malformed JSON fails collection
Initial build and compile results excluded as unowned; no retry or legacy payout collector call
Internal PASS is retained independently of outer wrapper recording FAIL; verified internal compile success keeps build and compile-result mandatory
Outer summary/started/invocation/exit: copy original bytes first, then validate required fields/types/phase order/call counts/exit consistency; unknown or damaged evidence cannot prove NOT_RUN
